shared_elements: bearded male figure in strict profile facing right
stylised beard rendered as rows of regular curls/beads
patterned garment with beaded or fringed borders
low-relief carving of court figures on a stone panel
hair rendered as dotted/bead-like curls at the nape
justification: Both depict bearded dignitaries in strict profile facing the same direction, with the identical conventions of beard and hair as rows of tight bead-like curls, an ear ornament, a tall headdress and beaded garment borders in shallow relief — an arbitrary and highly specific combination. The main difference is scope: A shows two full standing figures interacting, one presenting a round object to the other, while B is a single bust-length head and shoulders with no accompanying figure or held object.
